title: Evaluating the Impact of Privacy Regulation on E-Commerce Firms: Evidence from Apple's App Tracking Transparency
eligible_reason: Single adoption date (Apple ATT, April 2021) for all firms; treated groups are defined by baseline exposure (top quartile of pre-ATT Meta or iOS revenue share) and estimated with after##treated TWFE (reghdfe, viewid + month FE), xtevent event studies, and did_had (de Chaisemartin et al. heterogeneous-adoption design with continuous exposure). Advertising-side regressions are time-dummy regressions by platform/objective. No unit-specific adoption dates; shipped data are synthetic (ads) or noise-added (revenue).
design_notes: Package final_replication_files: README.txt, code/full_replication.R (lfe::felm, SYNTHETIC flag), code/replication_revenue.do (reghdfe log_trans_rev after##treated, absorb(viewid month) cluster(viewid); xtevent; did_had), data/merged_data_all.dta (firm x month revenue panel with additive noise, ~130k rows), fb/google/tiktok_synthetic.csv, att_adoption.dta.
modern_estimators_named: did_had (de Chaisemartin, D'Haultfoeuille et al. heterogeneous adoption design)
